purpose: Single final evaluation of the locked FT_BALANCED model policy on the duplicate-safe holdout split
individual_model_protocol: Evaluate each locked checkpoint independently using the same frozen threshold

ensemble_protocol.method: Unweighted arithmetic mean of the five locked checkpoint probabilities
ensemble_protocol.name: five_checkpoint_soft_voting_ensemble

reporting_protocol.robustness_result: Mean, standard deviation, minimum, and maximum across the five individual checkpoints
reporting_protocol.generalization_gap: Holdout minus validation at the same frozen threshold

resume_policy: Completed probability vectors may be reused after an interruption, but the frozen plan cannot be changed
